comments.body: issue (medium): 🟡 **Phase 6 still gives Full the Lite create-pr call** **(non-blocking)** Row 3 is marked `Full + Lite` but calls only `--no-post-review`, so a Full run repeats Step 3's review in Step 5.5. Lines 34 and 278, `companion-skills.md:110`, and `overview.md:130` say the same. Evidence: `skills/workflow/autonomous-workflow/rules/phase-6-pr-creation.md:278` (checklist) · `skills/workflow/autonomous-workflow/rules/companion-skills.md:110` (registry row) ```markdown | 3 | `Skill("create-pr", "--no-post-review")` (Full adds `--no-pre-review`) → local review-loop on Lite, push, open draft PR, watch initial CI | Full + Lite | ``` `pr-reviewer` · commit `83a6f70`

issue (medium): 🟡 **Flagged findings can never satisfy Full's goal** **(non-blocking)** The `/goal` needs every review finding printed fixed or rejected, but `review-loop` can leave one `flagged`, which this line sends to `Needs you:`. Such a run spins to the turn cap. Evidence: `skills/workflow/autonomous-workflow/aw/rules/full-tier.md:48` (goal template) · `skills/workflow/autonomous-workflow/rules/goal-emission.md:34` (goal template) ```text /goal run-checks prints "CHECKS / PASS", the Before-PR command prints "exit=0", the review findings are printed as fixed, declined, or flagged, and the draft PR URL is printed — or stop after turns or when a line starting "BLOCKED:" is printed. review: findings — fixed, declined, flagged | not run () ``` _Pseudo-code — verify before applying._ `pr-reviewer` · commit `83a6f70`

suggestion (medium): 🟡 **Default runs lose the critical review lens** **(non-blocking)** The removed Phase 7 row ran `review-loop` with `--critical`, and the local pass has no such lens. Say so in the description, or carry `--critical` into the local loop. `pr-reviewer` · commit `83a6f70`

suggestion (low): ⚪ **Stale pr-reviewer references after the Phase 7 removal** **(non-blocking)** Phase 7 no longer runs `pr-reviewer`, but its gaps still list it as not installed. The Phase 6 resource note at line 152 also still names `pr-reviewer` as the default loop. Evidence: `skills/workflow/autonomous-workflow/rules/phase-6-pr-creation.md:152` (resource note) `pr-reviewer` · commit `83a6f70`
